title: Chief Minister's Health Insurance Scheme (CMHIS) – Nagaland Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Government health insurance programme for eligible Nagaland residents, with coverage pathways for general beneficiaries and government employees under current rules.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility depends on the beneficiary category, Nagaland residency and current CMHIS enrolment rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Chief Minister's Health Insurance Scheme (CMHIS) – Nagaland.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
